shortfall.safeTitle: All of this is a simulation
shortfall.safeText: It is calculated on a copy of your data: nothing changes until you confirm “Apply”. Scheduled payments and recorded transactions are never changed, and no loans or new debt are suggested.
shortfall.lever.daily: Assumption: spend {to} a day on variable expenses instead of {from}
shortfall.noneTitle: No shortfall in the next {days} days
shortfall.noneText: The lowest projected balance is {lowest} on {date}.
shortfall.summaryTitle: When and how much is short
shortfall.first: The balance drops below zero on {date}: {amount} short at the end of that day.
shortfall.firstStart: Your real balance today is already below zero: {amount} short.
shortfall.dailyTotal: Estimated variable spending over those days
shortfall.endOfDay: Projected balance at the end of {date}
shortfall.obligationNote: Scheduled payments are treated as mandatory: the plan never moves or reduces them. If one really changed, edit it in the calendar.
shortfall.incomeScenario: variable income: the chosen scenario is used
shortfall.lateIncome: {name} was due on {date} and isn't marked: it isn't counted.
shortfall.noIncome: No scheduled income in this period.
shortfall.goalsNote: Goal set-asides stay in your account: they don't change the projected balance, so releasing them doesn't prevent the shortfall.
shortfall.leversIntro: Each option is simulated separately. Tick several to see the combined effect and adjust dates or amounts.
shortfall.noLevers: There are no planned purchases or assumptions to change in this period.
shortfall.partialTitle: No shortfall up to {until}; no figure from {date}
shortfall.partialText: The lowest projected balance up to {until} is {lowest} on {lowestDate}. From {date} it exceeds what Clara can calculate exactly, so nothing is claimed about the rest of the {days} days.
shortfall.partialNote: The projection only has figures up to {until}: the shortfall and the levers are computed over those days; from {date} nothing is claimed.
shortfall.partialNoneTitle: No figure from today: nothing can be projected
shortfall.partialNoneText: Already today’s closing balance exceeds what Clara can calculate exactly: nothing is claimed about the {days} days. Nothing is rounded or clamped.
shortfall.partialNoteNone: The projection has no day with an exact figure: the shortfall is today’s real balance and nothing is claimed about the rest.
shortfall.leverPartial: No shortfall up to {until}; no figure from {date}
shortfall.leverPartialNone: No exact figure from today: it is not claimed to prevent it
shortfall.combinedResolves: It no longer drops below zero: the lowest point is {lowest} on {date}.
shortfall.unresolved: Unresolved constraints: these scheduled payments are not changed and the rest isn't enough to cover them.
shortfall.simulationOnlyNote: Assumptions (income or daily spending) only change the simulation: they are never added to your available money.
shortfall.applyNote: Only planned purchases and estimated income amounts are applied. It is recorded in the history and can be undone.
shortfall.confirmTitle: Apply these changes to your plan?
shortfall.confirmText: Exactly this will change, all together:
shortfall.notApplied_one: {count} ticked assumption is not applied: it was only a simulation.
shortfall.notApplied_other: {count} ticked assumptions are not applied: they were only a simulation.
shortfall.conflict: Something changed since the proposal was calculated. Check the new values and try again: nothing was applied.
shortfall.unresolvedSpending: No scheduled payments are involved: the shortfall comes from estimated variable spending or planned purchases.
shortfall.lever.remove: Remove the planned purchase “{name}” ({amount}); it goes to the trash and can be restored
